Sjekklisten ligger i [tasks.md](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system/blob/main/tasks.md); fullført arbeid foldes inn i [endringsloggen](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
